content: BLAND! While this is a decent pasta recipe, it totally lacks flavor. Would make again in a pinch, but its definitely needs some doctoring.
Absolutely love this recipe! Perfect weekend breakfast or bunch! I used fresh wholemade sourdough and it was to die for. If you have it, top with a little bit of shaved parmiganparmigiano reggiano
Great option for a healthy breakfast in a pinch. I like to add Honey to mine for extra Sweetness.
I didnt have milk so I used french vanilla coffee creamer instead. Other than that, I followed the recipe exactly. The Mac and cheese was incredibly sweet and almost inedible. Will not try again!
While the sandwich is good, to compare it to a Croque Monsuir is a bit of a stretch. Its just a ham and cheese sandwich
